name: Gas Leak Detector
summary: MQ-2 gas sensor with an LED and buzzer. Warms up, learns what clean air reads, and alarms relative to that instead of a fixed number.
hardware: Arduino Uno (COM8 — the second board, not the parking sensor one)
MQ-2 gas sensor — VCC:5V, GND:GND, AO:A5 (the module's 'A0' pin goes to A5), DO unused
LED — long leg via 220-330R resistor to pin 7 (confirmed), short leg to GND
Piezo buzzer — + to pin 8, - to GND
notes: NOT a certified safety device — an uncalibrated MQ-2 cannot report a real concentration. gas_original/ is the restore point. The sensor needs ~30s warm-up before readings mean anything, and the baseline is learned in clean air. Uses the Uno on COM8; the parking sensor uses a different board on COM3.
